730:t_10:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Besides, he wants to pay the $$御使い$$s back more than anyone. He'll wake up for sure.」

730:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Please hurry, $n... Your battle... and humanity's, will soon reach its end...)

730:t_10:22.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm told his condition resembles $$刹那$$'s during the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ incident. His brain cells were placed under tremendous strain, leaving him unconscious.」

730:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He took in the wills of everyone in $c. It is understandable...」

730:t_10:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Why did $n do something like that...?」

730:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You must understand too, Miss $$スズネ$$. Neither $n nor $$アサキム$$ cares about the means, as long as they achieve their goal.」

730:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If necessary, $n would even give up his own life.」

730:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The battle that is about to begin...」

730:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It will be the final battle, against the enemy $n has pursued ever since he first boarded $$ジェニオン$$ that day.」

731:t_000:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We have arrived at 150 degrees east longitude on the equator. All units have finished deploying as well.」

731:t_000:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So this is $$エス・テラン$$... The Earth of the $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

731:t_000:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The low gravity makes the atmosphere thin. At high altitude, one could say it is no different from outer space.」

731:t_000:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In addition, the structure of this world is the same as the $$カオス・コスモス$$. This is another space where anything goes.」

731:t_000:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「So we can use $$天元突破グレンラガン#robot$$ and $$ダイバスター$$ on this planet too.」

731:t_000:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「But $$アサキム$$ himself isn't here yet...」

731:t_000:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「By the way, this spot is where $$リモネシア$$ was on our Earth.」

731:t_000:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So this is where the $$カラミティ・バース$$ happened...」

731:t_000:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「This is an important point in Earth's ley lines. Perhaps that is why it is a special place in every parallel world as well.」

731:t_000:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「In $$ＡＤＷ$$, it was $$リモネシア$$, the largest producer of $$ＤＥＣ$$... In the world of the $$フロンティア船団$$, it was $$マヤン島$$... And...」

731:t_000:10.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「In $$インサラウム$$, this was the site of the Holy Capital.」

731:t_000:11.en:
$$エスター$$
「That's why $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ was installed there...」

731:t_000:12.en:
$$トライア$$
「Earth is the ideal place to gather $$次元力|lc$$, and the gathered planets nourish Earth itself...」

731:t_000:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$御使い$$s probably used that power to build the system called $$至高神ソル$$.」

731:t_002:1.en:
$$シン$$
「You called us here and then showed up late! Who the hell do you think you are?!」

731:t_002:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wait, $$シン$$. We should talk to him first.」

731:t_002:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$アサキム$$... What did you mean when you said 'That's right' just now?」

731:t_002:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I meant what you said about the scenery here looking like graves.」

731:t_002:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「This is $$サクリファイ$$'s garden... A place to mourn the countless lives the $$御使い$$s have taken.」

731:t_002:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So this is... her place of mourning...」

731:t_002:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「Why did you choose this place for our final battle?」

731:t_002:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「On this lifeless planet, this is the only place where I can feel death...」

731:t_002:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I simply thought that made it suitable for our reckoning.」

731:t_002:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Do you... even intend to talk to us?!」

731:t_002:12.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I only agreed because you asked. I would like you to appreciate how unusual that is for me.」

731:t_002:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Indeed. I never imagined I could converse with someone who only ever says what he wishes to say.」

731:t_002:14.en:
$$桂$$
「So even you're getting a little melancholy before our final battle?」

731:t_002:15.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It is pointless to measure me by the standards of your emotions.」

731:t_002:16.en:
$$エスター$$
(Every damn thing he says pisses me off!)

731:t_002:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Hold it in. We should leave this to $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$ first.)

731:t_002:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$アサキム$$... Do we really have to do this?」

731:t_002:20.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If your goal is to fight the $$御使い$$s, we could cooperate...」

731:t_002:21.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Would that be all right with you, $$セツコ$$? Are you saying you can forgive me for taking the lives of those dear to you?」

731:t_002:22.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Your dead comrades would be even sadder than you if you said you forgave me.」

731:t_002:24.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アサキム$$! You bastard...!」

731:t_002:25.en:
$$勝平$$
「Do you enjoy making Sis $$セツコ$$ suffer so much?!」

731:t_002:26.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アサキム$$...! Was that your answer?!」

731:t_002:27.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I need the $$スフィア$$s' power to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

731:t_002:28.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The four I possess and the four you possess... Only with eight $$スフィア$$s can I finally fight them on equal terms.」

731:t_002:29.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then, if we combine our strength...」

731:t_002:30.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I told you that you cannot defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

731:t_002:32.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I can see how it ends: they take your $$スフィア$$s. That is why I will hunt them first.」

731:t_002:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you obtain the $$スフィア$$s, will you defeat the $$御使い$$s and stop the universe's great collapse?」

731:t_002:34.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That does not interest me. Let what will perish, perish.」

731:t_002:36.en:
$$アルト$$
「Just because you're immortal, you don't care if other lives disappear?!」

731:t_002:38.en:
$n
「That self-righteousness... You're just like the $$御使い$$s!」

731:t_002:39.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I cannot accept those words.」

731:t_002:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Did that make you angry...? Even you couldn't stand being compared to your sworn enemies, it seems.」

731:t_002:41.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$アサキム$$... Do you fight them because they made your body immortal?」

731:t_002:43.en:
$$ランド$$
「Why the hell did they do that to you?」

731:t_002:44.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Because I had the power to detect fragments of the shattered $$太極$$... the $$スフィア$$s.」

731:t_002:45.en:
$$赤木$$
「Why do you have that power?」

731:t_002:46.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Who knows...? But when I came to my senses, they had bound me in chains of causality...」

kept_omissions: 730:t_10:20: Suzune's nine-dot silence shows concern for unconscious Hibiki before AG asks about him.
730:t_10:29: Suzune falls silent after AG says nobody can stop Hibiki's self-sacrifice.
730:t_10:31: AG introduces 'The battle that is about to begin' as a hanging topic; 730:t_10:32 identifies it as the final battle with Hibiki's enemy.
730:t_10:33: Suzune privately addresses Hibiki by his player name after AG's reassurance.
731:t_000:9: Traia ends the parallel-world location list at 'And'; Marguerite supplies Insaraum's Holy Capital in 731:t_000:10.
731:t_000:14: Setsuko calls the planet beautiful, then trails off at 'But' as she senses its lifelessness; Asakim answers in 731:t_001:0.
731:t_002:0: Setsuko shouts Asakim's name on his arrival.
731:t_002:23: Setsuko starts 'I' but cannot complete her reply to Asakim's accusation about forgiving her comrades' deaths.
731:t_002:24: Kamille's unfinished 'You bastard' address conveys indignation at Asakim's taunting of Setsuko.
731:t_002:29: Setsuko leaves the conditional about combining their strength unfinished; Asakim rejects it in 731:t_002:30.
731:t_002:31: Rand's 'You bastard' is an angry address after Asakim denies their ability to win; no invented accusation is added.
uncertain: 731:t_000:12: The source explicitly says gathered stars/planets nourish Earth. 'Gathered planets' is retained literally; the line does not say gathered power.
